subject: Renewal: Ops & Support upgrade alignment — premium response tiers and latency agreement
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: FastCommerce renewal — ops uplift prep

Team —

FastCommerce renewal is live for May 1. Daniel asked for a firm plan to upgrade to our Premium Support tier and to bake a 99.5th percentile latency SLO into the new term. Key asks from the customer call:
- Premium support (24x7 response with P1 1-hour initial response)
- A 99th/99.5th tail latency commitment (they run chat-heavy flows)
- A burst capacity guarantee for Black Friday-style events (30% uplift for 3 hours)

Notes from the product point of view: our current Dedicated config for them is a 4-GPU pool with prefix caching enabled; hitting the 99.5th will require an SLA profile that allows increased reserved capacity during business-critical windows or a documented fallback plan to a slightly larger quantized model during surges.

Request: Ben, can you draft the pricing delta for Premium + the committed burst window? Marissa, need the operational runbook and proposed SLO language (including measurement windows and enforcement/credits). Priyom, please pull the last 6 weeks of latency histograms and token volumes (we'll attach).

I'll coordinate the customer-facing doc and propose a timeline for sign-off by 4/20 so we can hit the May 1 start date.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: FC_MA_Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx (XLSX, 42 KB)]

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@fastcommerce.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, ops@fastcommerce.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fastcommerce.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FastCommerce renewal — ops uplift prep

Mina —

Appreciate the quick follow. A few clarifications from our side:
- Premium support: we need confirmation that P1 will be an on-call engineer within 1 hour and updates every 2 hours until resolution.
- Latency SLO: we are asking for 99.5th token-latency <= 400ms for our typical chat prompt distribution. If that requires reserving extra capacity for the top 10% windows, we want that baked into the contract as an option (we can pay for reserved burst).
- During promotional spikes (we run 2–3 hour windows ~monthly), we'd like a guaranteed uplift that prevents throttling.

We can be flexible on price but need clear escalation points (including an option to escalate to an engineering on-call and an exec review if repeated misses). If you can send the proposed SLO wording and delta pricing by EOD 4/14, we can route internally and aim for signature by 4/22.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Head of Platform
FastCommerce

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FastCommerce renewal — ops uplift prep (proposal attached)

Hi Daniel / Elena —

Thanks for the clarifications. Attached is a concise proposal; highlights below and the attached "FC_Premium_SLA_RevB.pdf" contains full legal language for the SLO and credits.

Summary of proposal
- Support: Premium Support (24x7) with P1 initial response within 60 minutes; follow-up cadence every 2 hours until mitigation. Escalation to engineering on-call within 3 hours for incidents classified as systemic.
- Latency SLO: 99.5th percentile token-latency <= 420ms, measured over a rolling 7-day window with daily sampling. Credit framework: 5% service credit for >1 violation/month; escalated remediation plan for repeated misses.
- Burst capacity: Option A (preferred): Reserved burst pool +30% capacity for up to 3 hours per month (pre-booked windows) — additional months' unused minutes roll over up to 2 months. Option B: Auto-burst policy with dynamic quantized fallback (lower cost model) that provides capacity but may increase median latency by ~10–20ms.
- Price delta: Premium support + burst option A — incremental $11,500/month. Option B: +$6,800/month with auto-fallback exclusions. Detailed line items in attached XLSX.

Attachments included:
- FC_Premium_SLA_RevB.pdf (legal SLO language and credit table)
- FC_MA_Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx (pricing delta and line items)
- response-time-histogram.png (6-week tail latency histogram)

Next steps suggested:
1) You confirm whether you prefer Option A or B for burst.
2) If Option A: confirm which 3-hour monthly window(s) to reserve for May–Jul (we'll provision capacity the week prior).
3) If all good, we will issue a one-page amendment for signature and provide a DocuSign link.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if you'd prefer to walk through.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: FC_Premium_SLA_RevB.pdf (PDF, 18 KB); FC_MA_Pricing_Sheet_v3.xlsx (XLSX, 42 KB); response-time-histogram.png (PNG, 120 KB)]

Date: 2027-04-14T16:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FastCommerce renewal — ops uplift prep (confirmation + next steps)

Daniel / Elena —

Thanks for the quick review. To confirm what Mina sent: FastCommerce selected Option A (reserved burst pool +30% for 3 hours/month). We will provision the reserved pool and schedule the first reserved window for May 10 10:00–13:00 PT as a pilot — please confirm if that slot works for you.

I have prepared the amendment and included the pricing figures; you'll receive a DocuSign link from our contracts team (link below). After signature we will:
- Schedule a provisioning call with our infra team to reserve the pool (we provision within 5 business days of signature).
- Share the operational runbook and SRE contact for on-call escalation.
- Enable the SLO dashboard on your tenant with daily reporting.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/ABCD-1234
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/FC-12345

Please reply with a quick confirmation of the May 10 pilot window or propose an alternate.

Best,
Ben Carter
